title: The Emptied Room
logline: An elderly householder gives away what is left of a home of sixty years, and the film's last movement carries Chathura from that doorway to the crowded place that Episodes 1 and 100 share.
human_question: What is left when a person stops adding anything to their life and only ever takes away?

situation.what_happens: An old person closing a house they have lived in for decades decides what goes where: what is given to whom, what is kept, what is simply left. The process is practical and slow, and it is mostly subtraction, since almost nothing new comes in at this stage of a life. One or two things turn out to be harder to part with than expected, and that is where the real decisions are. At the end the rooms are emptier than they have been in a lifetime.
situation.who_is_involved: The householder; the adult children or relatives who are receiving things, and who may be the reason for the move; neighbours who have known the house for decades; whoever will use the house next.
situation.what_is_at_stake: Independence, memory and dignity. For the family, an unresolved question about what is being lost. For the film, the risk of intruding on a grief-shaped transition or making old age and having little look beautiful.
situation.how_it_unfolds: These moves usually begin as a practical necessity and take weeks, with objects sorted, re-sorted and argued over. The pressure is a date, someone's health, or a family decision already made. It ends when the house is handed over, and the person's own view of it may not settle for a long time afterwards. Reality decides what the elder says, what they keep, and whether they want the film there at all.

concept_merge.why_together: C073 (nibbana, the fourth ultimate) contributes the group's final claim: the sources describe their peace as unconditioned, realised rather than produced, neither a feeling nor a place, and the Margaya says it is very near and simply covered over [C073-M:L3–L7; C073-P:L20; C073-P:L62]. C015 (immaterial resultant and functional minds) contributes a guard the ending needs: even the longest and most refined result the texts describe is still a result that ends, so a quiet, reduced life is not the thing being pointed at [C015-M:L22]. C102 (the attainment of cessation) contributes the shape of a responsible letting go, the same preliminary duties the previous film watched, here turned the other way: not securing a life to come back to, but settling it with no return planned [C102-P:L43–L62].
concept_merge.what_it_reveals: Together they let the group end on its subject without claiming it. A life visibly ceasing to add anything is the nearest thing a camera can approach, and the concepts, taken together, insist on the distance: this is not the peace, a long quiet life is not the peace, and nothing here is an attainment. What becomes visible is the shape of an idea, held at arm's length, in a room that is emptying.

concept_links.why: The sources describe their final peace as not produced by effort but realised, not a location or a pleasant feeling, and the Margaya calls it very near and simply covered, with effort clearing what covers it [C073-M:L3–L7; C073-P:L20; C073-P:L62]. The film cannot show that; it can watch a life that has stopped adding to itself, and say no more.

The digest warns that a long peaceful existence is not the goal in this teaching, because however refined and however long, it is still a result that ends and still counted among the mundane minds [C015-M:L22]. That is the guard this film needs against reading a quiet, reduced old age as the answer. The Margaya's cake-and-rice image and its remark about a happiness close to nibbana's are flagged in the digest as needing a teacher's framing, and the film should not use them.

The four preliminary duties tie even the deepest withdrawal to belongings, to the community and to the time one has [C102-P:L43–L62]. Here that responsibility appears in reverse, as a life settled without a planned return; the digest restricts the attainment itself to rare, already-liberated people, so no equivalence is drawn and the elder is never implied to be approaching anything.

what_the_viewer_could_understand: The peace the texts point to at the end of the road is not something made or gained, and it is not a feeling or a place. They describe it as very near but covered over, and as the last of the four basic realities the series began with.
what_must_be_real: A real elder's real, willing decision about a real home, and their own account of it, with consent they and their family control throughout. The film never suggests the elder has attained anything, and it does not treat their age, solitude or having little as an achievement. The closing crowded-location event is the planned shared image with Episodes 1 and 100 and is observed, not arranged.
position_hint: closing candidate: it is the group's answer held inside one life, someone who only ever takes away, and it hands directly to the planned crowded-location event that ends the chronological slate and is shared with Episode 1 and Episode 100.
risks: Intruding on a grief-shaped or contested family transition
Romanticising old age, solitude or poverty
Implying the elder has attained anything, or that letting go of possessions is the peace the texts name
Letting the closing shared image be read as a claim rather than the series' planned hand-over
drop_if: No elder and family will consent with full dignity and the ability to stop at any point
The move is contested within the family, so that filming would take a side

connections.note: From preparing to leave and return, to setting a whole life in order with no return planned.
A different route to the same required closing event: one person's final letting go, or a group's return into the world.
The group opens on a debt set down and closes on a whole life set down.

selection.reason: Used by EPD-0098; C073 is the group's closing concept and the C015 link has been re-grounded on the warning rather than the flagged passage.

unknowns: No participant or event has been found or confirmed. Everything here is a research direction.
evidence_class_note: Editorial proposal. No location, scene or shot decisions are made at the idea stage.
